thread:
maya: quick heads-up — three mid-market customers asked for per-route cost attribution + trace linking so they can bill internal teams. timeline asked: ~6 weeks. :eyes:

alex: ok — sounds like two parts: (1) capture route+tenant metadata in traces/logs, (2) surface aggregated cost breakdowns in console.

brian: capturing metadata is cheapest if we add `route_id` and `tenant_id` to the request header propagation and ensure runtime injects into traces. cost: small CPU + storage for traces.

samira: from analytics side, we can pre-aggregate daily cost by route to avoid scanning traces for dashboards. that avoids heavy query costs but reduces granularity to 24h. tradeoff: live billing vs cheaper compute.

jun-ho: UX question — do customers want per-request drilldown or just a high-level per-route bar chart? we should mock both.

maya: customers asked for both: interactive drilldown (limited) + daily rollout summary. they specifically called out: "we need to show which route caused the spike and the top-k callers."

alex: implementation options: 
A) trace-tagging + sample traces (low perf impact) + pre-agg daily dashboard (low cost)
B) full per-request indexing (high fidelity) but high storage/query cost
C) hybrid: index error/high-latency requests and sample normal traffic.

brian: hybrid looks promising. index keys for error/latency > p95 and sample the rest at 0.1%. storage delta estimate: +12% for hybrid, +120% for full indexing.

samira: re: cost model UX — we can show two views: "estimated bill" (fast, approximate) and "reconciled bill" (accurate, slower). estimated uses pre-agg and cost heuristics.

maya: launch criteria proposal: 1) console shows per-route daily cost and top-5 call sites, 2) traces include `route_id` and `tenant_id` propagated, 3) error/latency indexing enabled with sampling, 4) docs + customer onboarding notes, 5) e2e test for tenant isolation of telemetry.

alex: dev plan: week1 add trace header propagation + runtime injection. week2 enable indexing and sampling in staging. week3 build dashboard tiles + API. week4 customer beta + docs.

jun-ho: I'll create two mockups: summary chart + drilldown modal. will post by EOD tomorrow. :art:

brian: ops-bot: deploy staging config `telemetry.indexing=hybrid-sample-0.1` when staging window opens.

ops-bot: scheduled deploy to staging at 2024-05-15T22:00Z for config `telemetry.indexing=hybrid-sample-0.1`. :white_check_mark:

samira: one gotcha — costs attribution needs to account for batching (tokens shared across requests). we'll need a heuristic to attribute batch cost to routes. propose: prorate by request token weight.

alex: good call. that means we need token-level counters per request or an estimate. token counters add tiny overhead in runtime but simplify attribution.

maya: prioritization note: enterprise customers + billing-sensitive mid-market jump this above other UX work. recommend we carve a focused 6-week sprint and treat as customer-driven eng sprint.

alex: agree. if we do hybrid indexing + pre-agg dashboards we can deliver MVP in 6 weeks with reasonable cost profile.

maya: action items:
- alex: add trace header propagation + token counters (week1)
- brian: capacity estimate + staging deploy (this week)
- jun-ho: mockups for dashboard + drilldown (tomorrow EOD)
- samira: aggregation queries + cost heuristics prototype (week1)
- maya: customer comms + beta invite list (this week)

alex: will create a PR for the header propagation today and tag the thread.

maya: thanks — please ping if scope needs to change. planning sync Friday 10am PT. :calendar:
